title: 产品目录、拆分履约与退货后的净结算
scope: Synthetic single-currency retail order; tax, shipping charge, FX, chargebacks and exchanges excluded. Quantity allocation, shipment, returns, refund attempts and settlement are independent. Provider objects are references, not a live Shopify/Stripe integration.

checks.given: 3 cups at 4000; 2 lids at 1000; discount 1001; north 2+2, south 1+0
checks.when: accept, allocate, deliver both shipments, return cup + first lid, confirm refund
checks.then: 5 shipped; returned 2; only cup restocked; refund 4642; net batch 8097
checks.evidence_required: UI snapshots, order and inventory ledger, provider/stub identities, refund and settlement records

checks.then: one refund effect and no additional restock
checks.evidence_required: inbox IDs, business key, unit refundable balance

checks.when: old packed and refund pending notifications arrive
checks.then: current authoritative states retained after reconciliation
checks.evidence_required: arrival log, current source response, final UI

checks.given: one available cup; two independent orders each need one
checks.then: one allocation succeeds; other receives shortage; availability never negative

checks.given: two stores have same visible order number and SKU
checks.when: query and refund using other store ID with cache hit and miss
checks.then: no foreign detail or side effect; account mapping cannot be client-overridden
checks.evidence_required: scoped query, authorization result, cache keys, refund ledger

checks.given: payment side accepted R but response lost
checks.when: operator retries and opens order elsewhere
checks.then: same R remains unknown until queried; no second refund
checks.evidence_required: operation record, UI feedback, external lookup and attempt count

checks.given: allocation and outbox committed; worker has not acknowledged
checks.then: one reservation and explained eventual delivery
checks.evidence_required: restart trace, unique key, quantity sum

checks.when: cancel south without confirming no handoff
checks.then: cancel remains pending; shipped 4 stays visible; no stock release
checks.evidence_required: warehouse lookup, allocation version, UI independent statuses

checks.given: refund succeeded but item not received, or lid received damaged
checks.when: naive refund-success handler attempts sellable restock
checks.then: reject restock; only inspected acceptable quantity can return to stock
checks.evidence_required: inspection and stock movement references; deliberately faulty path must fail

checks.when: largest remainder with stable unit IDs; return lids separately
checks.evidence_required: fixed fixture, integer steps, sum and permutation checks

checks.when: another refund references same unit or all five units total above 12999
checks.then: duplicate unit or over-cap refund refused
checks.evidence_required: unit refund ledger, approval/version, refusal detail

checks.given: A has cup only cost 4; B cup+lid cost 5
checks.when: compare greedy per-item and feasible single-warehouse assignment
checks.then: greedy 9 is not optimal; B-only 5; label heuristic honestly
checks.evidence_required: tiny exhaustive enumeration and objective values

checks.given: capture12999 refund4642 fee260 in same synthetic batch
checks.when: compare payout marked 8357 or same amount from another account
checks.then: raise discrepancy; expected 8097 and identity must match
checks.evidence_required: batch lines, account scope, adjustment explanation

checks.given: one unit reserved but not handed over; no return exists; original unit paid3714
checks.when: warehouse confirms no handoff, cancel, release reservation, request refund
checks.then: one cancellation-grounded refund up to3714; no fabricated physical return or second refund through return branch
checks.evidence_required: warehouse confirmation, order cancellation record, reservation movement, unit refund balance and UI
